config.design: All56 frozen H824 receivers,112 near/far relationships. Common-norm block/PCA16/random16 directions; separately native-scale block swaps. Zero edit per receiver. Native final-position distribution references.
config.selection: No outcome based changes; training PCA from original2048 documents only; random seed825+layer.
config.metrics: KL(receiver||edited); donor KL gain KL(donor||receiver)-KL(donor||edited); total variation; same receiver near/far effect differences. Different donor targets preclude interpreting raw near/far gain as direct superiority.
config.limitations: Small dependent block/receiver sample; natural donor does not ensure partial transplant on manifold; shared norm shrinks far edits. No task correctness claim.
